nodes.label: The Cre'Tez
nodes.summary: The fire genasi line turned tiefling, keepers of the fire key.

facts.t: The fire genasi who became the Cre'Tez have guarded the fire key since the sealing of the Princes.
Over the generations since Imix was sealed again, the line has turned tiefling.
A Seeker chapter told Vanifer the secret in the Cre'Tez blood.
The Cre'Tez estate is in Orerius, in T'Arionese, home of the Cre'Tez siblings.

nodes.label: Cenvinzo
nodes.summary: Head of the Cre'Tez.

facts.t: Cenvinzo is barely alive, a shadow of himself, held captive somewhere and bound to Vanifer.

nodes.label: Vanifer
nodes.summary: The eldest of the Cre'Tez siblings, a half-sister who uses the name Finerva; her dossier is dossiers/vanifer.html.

facts.t: Finerva is Vanifer under another name.
She slowly siphoned Benedetta for the Bloodstone.
When she tried to make her father concede, he invoked the Alpha and locked them both out.
Vanifer has a DM dossier: the half-sister who raised the younger Cre'Tez, and her plan for the inheritance.
She leads the fire cult, which treats Asmodus as its prophet on her orders.

nodes.label: Benedetta
nodes.summary: A Cre'Tez mother, siphoned to death.

facts.t: Benedetta fell ill at Rihiri's birth from Vanifer's siphoning and died two years later.

nodes.label: Rihiri
nodes.summary: A Cre'Tez sister.

facts.t: Rihiri is a Cre'Tez sister.
Lola's Boys freed Rihiri and Dharra from Elizar Dryflagon's fire cult in Baratol.

nodes.label: Dharra
nodes.summary: A Cre'Tez sister.

facts.t: Dharra is a Cre'Tez sister.

nodes.label: Asmodus
nodes.summary: A Cre'Tez brother hunting his siblings' birthrights.

facts.t: Asmodus started hunting his siblings after the Alpha was invoked.

nodes.label: Kevulan
nodes.summary: A Cre'Tez brother bound to Xero.

facts.t: Kevulan first willed his birthright to Asmodus, then rescinded it and willed it to Xero.

nodes.label: The Bloodstone
nodes.summary: An illegitimate stone Vanifer filled with a soul.

facts.t: Vanifer siphoned Benedetta's soul into an illegitimate Bloodstone over about two years.

nodes.label: The Pedra Ardente
nodes.summary: A fire-plane gem recovered from the Blooming Glass.

facts.t: The Pedra Ardente is a gem.
Clint's crew recovered it at the Blooming Glass and handed it to Finerva for the eldest brother.

nodes.label: Chloe Chespetes
nodes.summary: A fire genasi trapped for centuries in the lab she flooded with lava.

facts.t: Chloe Chespetes flooded a laboratory with lava to stop the sect summoning Imix, and was trapped there.

nodes.label: Lola's Boys
nodes.summary: The Fonains party, champions of the Accordance.

facts.t: Sent back by the Accordance, Lola's Boys took the planar craft's gems in the year 425.
Taking the gems brought down the craft, freed N'ghathrod and landed Tharizdun's foothold on their own world.
They destroyed the corrupted Fonains Monolith, which forced Vecna to change his plan.
They broke N'ghathrod's elder brain beneath the Barrier Peaks in Session 27.

nodes.label: Xero
nodes.summary: A member of Lola's Boys who saw the Eye.

facts.t: While ethereal in the year 425, Xero saw a giant purple slit-pupiled eye watching the party.
Kevulan's birthright is willed to Xero.

nodes.label: Eldree
nodes.summary: A silver pseudodragon with Lola's Boys.

facts.t: Bahamut's trapped aspect speaks through Eldree's egg.

nodes.label: Kwalish
nodes.summary: A gnome planar specialist with a gate and a planar device.

facts.t: Kwalish restarted the planar craft with the stolen gems and used its cannon on the Monolith.
He is within Clint's reach on Fonains, with a gate and a planar device.
His island laboratory is a broken-off piece of Thessalar's craft, and its cannon split the Fonains Monolith.

nodes.label: Giorge
nodes.summary: The bait of Vecna's ritual on the Darkest Day.

facts.t: Giorge may be trying to reach Shothragot's true vestige.
Giorge attacked Lola's Place for Ziko's sword.

nodes.label: Ziko
nodes.summary: A man dropped from the Monolith's cyst, his blade turned black.

facts.t: The Monolith's black cyst dropped Ziko when it broke, his blade turned black.

nodes.label: Aerisi Kalinoth
nodes.summary: Yan-C-Bin's prophet, the winged elf queen.

facts.t: Aerisi Kalinoth raised the spear on the floating island above the Feathergale Spire and called forth Yan-C-Bin.

nodes.label: The Sacred Stone
nodes.summary: The earth cult that seized the war pick.

facts.t: The Sacred Stone seized the dojos and took the war pick at the Tournament of Masters.

nodes.label: Gar Shatterkeel
nodes.summary: Holder of the trident.

facts.t: Gar Shatterkeel hears a voice in the water: the others are in motion.

nodes.label: The Green Lady
nodes.summary: Keeper of the Misty Vale, trapped in dragon form.

facts.t: The Green Lady fled to the Misty Vale about a century and a half ago and became its keeper.
Cut off from Eldath, she is trapped in dragon form.

nodes.label: The Misty Vale
nodes.summary: Where Eldath's tree held the air spear.

facts.t: Aerisi split Eldath's tree in the Misty Vale and left a black spiral on the altar.

nodes.label: Thessalar
nodes.summary: Halaster Blackcloak, the Mad Mage, still in his planar craft.

facts.t: Thessalar is Halaster Blackcloak, and he is still in the planar craft.
His records of the work on N'ghathrod are in the craft.
Tharizdun's influence reached him through the craft's gems and drove him slowly mad.
N'ghathrod was his first subject, and afterward he made eight simulacra of himself.
In the present of Fonains his name is forgotten.
He powers his work off the hazy yellow gem.
He was a high priest of Moloch and an artificer, and he pursues lichdom.
Lola's Boys took the red gem from the cavern lake and the hazy yellow gem from his workshop.

nodes.label: Thessalar's planar craft
nodes.summary: A vast floating city of many tiers that fell on Fonains about five hundred years ago; the Mad Mage's dungeon now.

facts.t: Thessalar held N'ghathrod prisoner aboard and experimented on him with the Rod's seventh piece.
Lola's Boys took its control and defence gems in the year 425; without them it fell, and N'ghathrod escaped in the fall.
Its gems formed where Olhydra and Ogrémoch collided, and they are not residue.
One of Tharizdun's temples was aboard; the crash is how the Elder Elemental Eye reached Fonains.
Its main body raised the Barrier Peaks; Daoine Gloine is a broken-off piece, and the Thessalkraken landed in the sea.
Thessalar is still inside, with his records and the seventh piece.
The craft is a megadungeon, the Mad Mage dungeon.
The piece holding Tharizdun's temple came down somewhere other than the Barrier Peaks.
Kwalish's island, the Monastery of the Distressed Body, is a broken-off piece of the craft.

nodes.label: The craft's gems
nodes.summary: The planar craft's control and defence gems.

facts.t: The craft's gems formed where Olhydra and Ogrémoch collided, and they are not Reach residue.
The gems carried Tharizdun's touch.
They were a red gem from the cavern lake and the hazy yellow gem from Thessalar's workshop.

nodes.label: The fall of the planar craft
nodes.summary: About five hundred years ago the craft fell, and N'ghathrod escaped.

facts.t: N'ghathrod used the chaos of the fall to escape with his five lieutenants and a few lesser illithids.
He never reached Fonains.
The crash brought Tharizdun's influence to Fonains with the temple aboard.

nodes.label: The Thessalkraken
nodes.summary: The kraken that came down with the craft, the Drowned God's kraken.

facts.t: The Thessalkraken landed separately in the sea and is the Drowned God's kraken.
It guarded the reef where the trident was sealed.

nodes.label: The Drowned God
nodes.summary: A god revered by kraken priests on Fonains.

facts.t: The Drowned God's kraken is the Thessalkraken.

nodes.label: The Barrier Peaks
nodes.summary: Mountains raised by the planar craft's main body.

facts.t: The planar craft's main body raised the Barrier Peaks.

nodes.label: Daoine Gloine
nodes.summary: A glass city, a broken-off piece of the planar craft.

facts.t: Daoine Gloine is a broken-off piece of the planar craft.

nodes.label: The Temple of Moloch
nodes.summary: A layer of the planar craft, above Thessalar's laboratory.

facts.t: The Temple of Moloch is one layer of the planar craft, with Thessalar's laboratory beneath it.

nodes.label: T'Arionese
nodes.summary: The northern realm of Fonains's southern continent, where the isthmus lands.

facts.t: T'Arionese is one of Fonains's eleven realms, the north of the southern continent.
Orerius, where the Cre'Tez estate stands, is in T'Arionese.

nodes.label: The Trentara Forest
nodes.summary: A forest in the north of Fonains's northern continent, where the remains of the Monolith lie.

facts.t: The Trentara Forest lies between Nomnia and the Kingdom of Shaumala.
The remains of the Fonains Monolith lie there: the black cyst, with the four great shards turning around it.
The eight days of storm fell heaviest there, and the air shard opened onto the Feathergale Spire.

nodes.label: Orerius
nodes.summary: In T'Arionese, on Fonains, where the Cre'Tez estate stands.

facts.t: Clint works bounties out of Orerius.
The Cre'Tez estate is in Orerius, in T'Arionese; it is the home of the Cre'Tez siblings.

nodes.label: Seldra
nodes.summary: A captive who senses precious gems by feel.

facts.t: Thessalar kept Seldra for her faculty of sensing gems by feel, and Lola's Boys freed her.

nodes.label: Krynn
nodes.summary: The world of the Dragon Queen, on the eve of the War of the Lance.

facts.t: Krynn's present is level with Caelestis's.
Takhisis is moving but not free, and the Dragon Armies are marching on Solamnia.
Krynn shares a system with Fonains.

nodes.label: The ruined temple of Paladine
nodes.summary: Where Takhisis holds an aspect of Bahamut.

facts.t: An aspect of Bahamut is trapped in the ruined temple of Paladine.

nodes.label: The Dragon Armies
nodes.summary: Takhisis's armies.

facts.t: The Dragon Armies march on Solamnia in the prelude to the War of the Lance.

nodes.label: The departed dragons
nodes.summary: The dragons that left Fonains and most worlds to face Takhisis.

facts.t: The dragons that left Fonains and most worlds set out to face Takhisis and have not reached Krynn.
Their own politics hold them.

nodes.label: The sealing of the Princes
nodes.summary: About twelve thousand years ago the Accordance sealed the Princes.

facts.t: The six gods of the Accordance helped forge four weapons and sealed the Princes with them as keys.

nodes.label: The war over Imix
nodes.summary: About three and a half centuries ago Imix was sealed again.

facts.t: A fire genasi sect tried to summon Imix, and Asmodeus gave the few who resisted Tinderstrike.

nodes.label: Expansion
nodes.summary: The Axiom that spreads things apart.

facts.t: Expansion stretched space and gave the first differences room.
The drift between galaxies belongs to Expansion.
The Expansion fragment has five pieces.

nodes.label: GAL-05
nodes.summary: A galaxy beside Caelestis's, partway toward waking its core.

facts.t: GAL-05's fate turns on what happens in GAL-01.

nodes.label: Krynnspace (CSC 16423)
nodes.summary: A star system of two known worlds, Krynn and Fonains, reached from Realmspace on an uncharted route.

facts.t: Krynnspace, CSC 16423, holds Krynn (CSC 16423 b) and Fonains (CSC 16423 c).
